test_title: PYST 44: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some H are R.

II. No P are H.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some P are H.

II. Some R are not P.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
Given:

Statements:

I. Some H are R.

II. No P are H.

The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f79e27c357263a64cc715e8a215e0156d5f46c58914c3e0881a2c04595033b55.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some P are H. → **Doesn't follow**. (No P are H, so some P can never be H.)

II. Some R are not P. → **Follows**. (Some H are R and No P are H, this implies that some R are definitely not P.)

Therefore, only conclusion II follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
